The attack was launched at 03:30hrs on the 5th of July.  The three SS divisions moved on three parallel lines of advance.  Fighting through thick minefields north of Byelgorod, Leibstandarte was by 19:30hrs on the southern outskirts of Jakovleva, a village within the second defensive line some 14 miles into Soviet territory, and had taken 97 killed and 522 wounded.

After a night marked by continuous infantry battles in puring rain, by dawn the Leibstandarte assaulted bunkers and fortified positions in the second line of defensive works.  In a day of heavy fighting, the panzers of the Leibstandarte engaged the 1st Guards Armoured Brigade and destroyed a large part of it.  The advanced carried the front line to Pokrovka, south-west of Prokhorovka.

The aims of Operation Spring Awakening were as wildly ambitious as those laid out for the Ardennes offensive three months previously.  They were: to destroy the Soviet forces in the region bounded by Lake Balaton and the Danube and Drava rivers, secure the Hungarian oil deposits, and establish bridgeheads over the Danube with a view to further offensive operations.

Despite battling hard the Leibstandarte and the rest of the 1st Panzer Army were forced from Rostov.  The defeat badly exposed how overstretched the German forces were.  The fighting had left the Leibstandarte decimated.  At the end of November it was pulled out and spent December in defensive positions outside Rostov behind the River Mius.  It was engaged in defensive actions, in temperatures that sank as low as -40 degrees, with deep carpets of snow and partisan actions in the rear.

Comrade General, Your troops did excellent job! You have taken a bridgehead on the Vistula's western bank. This will be the basis for our offensive that should liberate Poland from Fascist-capitalist oppression!
Outstanding work, General.  You have continued to display superior skill.  We will not be having much of a problem with the remaining Republicans.  Good luck on your next assignment.

I am aware that conditions have been harsh, but you have done poorly!  The only positive result is that you and your troops have gained some experience in this new type of armored warfare.   But, the new Spanish government and our other allies have not yet learned to respect our military capabilities, which we require!   Herr General, do not disappoint us again.
Welcome to Poland, Herr General.

Your task is to lead your SS PanzerKorps into Poland and destroy the Polish Army around Lodz.  You will be fighting the best of the Polish Army, and the battle will depend upon how quickly you can eliminate these enemy forces and seal off any their escape routes.
Herr General, How could you let the Poles defeat your mighty PanzerKorps?
There are rumors from Berlin about a replacement for your command.
However, I have no time for such things, There is a war still to be fought and I need your PanzerKorps for the final assault on Warszawa.
Do not fail me again Herr General.

General, you have been assigned the ultimate objective: Your SS PanzerKorps must destroy the remaining Polish forces situated around Warszawa and secure the Polish Capital.  Be aware that if you go too far east you may encounter our new Allies.
The Fatherland is watching you!
Herr General, You have failed!
Due to your incompetence, the Soviets are moving further West every day.
I recognize you have friends in Berlin, but keep this level of performance up and even they won't be able to save you.
Well well, General.
The Finns are very impressed.  Your elite divisions bring glory to the Fatherland.  Germany needs more Generals like you!
You have once again defeated a numerically superior enemy with your elite SS units, even the British are impressed, on to France, Herr General!
Herr General, the invasion of France has begun.  Your force will move swiftly and quietly through the Ardennes and attack the French where they least expect.
Cross the Meuse and destroy any resistance you find.  The French have been called the best army in the world, but frankly, we haven't found them very impressive.
Excellent!  You have achieved a tremendous victory against incredible odds.  Move quickly, now, and destroy the last British forces at Dunkirk!
Well Herr General, you handled that counter attack very nicely.  I think some of the Allied Generals have studied your tactics!
Now you must move against the last British forces at Dunkirk.
Herr General, the British have successfully embarked their Expeditionary Force and the French continue to resist.
If this is the way you handle your forces, I do not think your PanzerKorps will be required for the final battle against the French.
Your forces are being transferred east where you cannot interfere with the war effort further.
Herr General, on every other front the Russians are melting before our forces like a slab of butter on a skillet.
How is it you have failed?
You had best pray this war lasts a bit longer so you will have a chance to redeem yourself.
Herr General, you exceed our expectations!  The Russians are retreating on all fronts.  Prepare for your next objective!
Herr General, we need your skill and daring once again!

Take your PanzerKorps and capture the important town of Zhytomyr.  Intelligence reports the remainder of a Soviet army group is in the vicinity, but you should be able to handle them and destroy any Russian forces foolish enough to continue fighting!
The high command sends it highest regards!  Every other army commander envies you and your SS PanzerKorps!  Continue with the war, Herr General!
Herr General, You've taken Zhytomyr after fierce resistance.
I know your forces are in need of a rest, nevertheless we must press on to Kyiv at once!
A fine performance, to be sure. Kyiv has fallen; the Bolshevik armies are cut off without hope of relief.  And now, we might be able to threaten Moscow.
Herr General, I hope you can withstand this cold.  The 1st SS PanzerKorps must capture V'Az'ma.  This city will be a stepping stone and a base of operations for the final attack on Moscow!
If you succeed, we will all enjoy the spring back in Berlin!
Well done, Herr General!  They couldn't stop your advance.  The occupation of V'Az'ma will be critical towards your next objective.
On to Moskva!  Nothing can stop you now!
Herr General, you failed to take V'Az'ma!
This will make our attack on Moskva far more difficult.
Nevertheless, we must make that assault or face a winter in Russia!
Herr General, fine performance.  The occupation of V'Az'ma will be critical towards your next objective.
Next we assault Moskva!
General, this is the attack all of Germany has been waiting for.  You and your SS PanzerKorps have been chosen because of your brilliant victories for the last two years.
The Russians have erected considerable defenses around Moskva, but you must break through and capture their capitol.  Move quickly before they bring in more reinforcements from the east.
Herr General, after your incredible victory, the entire Russian line is in complete collapse.
The Soviet armies are fleeing east; The Fuher himself has demanded your presence in Berlin to award your medal!
We should have no trouble crushing the remaining forces.

You have been summoned to Berlin.

Due to your incompetence the troops assigned the task to take Kursk will suffer greatly.

Well done Herr General.  Now that we have Obojan, we can continue towards Kursk.
Welcome to Kursk, Herr General.
